Name: CLO Transmission Path
Key_Insight: Japan bid anchoring. Trigger is US credit cycle, not Japan selling.

Name: CRE Doom Loop
Key_Insight: Banks buffered by healthy Industrial. Office is contained crisis.

Name: FHLB Contagion Cascade
Key_Insight: Bank stress → FHLB haircuts tighten → Forced asset sales → CRE prices fall → Other bank collateral impaired → Further haircuts → Cascade. Joint & several liability = no member isolation.

Name: VLY Dual Exposure Cascade
Key_Insight: VLY Q4 2025 BEAT expectations. Thesis challenged but structural risk remains. Employment break needed for transmission.

Name: Fund Finance Transmission
Key_Insight: LP stress → Capital calls drawn → CFG/VLY/ZION liquidity drain → Exactly when FHLB haircuts tighten → Triple squeeze: collateral + liquidity + funding costs.

Name: HOA Super-Lien Cascade
Key_Insight: Special assessments unpaid → Super-lien filings (priority over mortgage) → Bank recovery impairment → LGD increases → Reserve builds required.

Name: CRE Extend-and-Pretend Collapse
Key_Insight: Modification → 12-month window expires → Re-default (>50% rate) → Second modification → Exhaustion → Forced recognition → Charge-off cascade. FLG 142bps allowance cut = reverse indicator.

Name: Open-End Fund NAV Cascade
Key_Insight: Redemption surge → Fund gates (BREIT 2%/mo) → Forced asset sales at discount → Shadow NAV revealed → Peer funds markdown → Pension actuarial losses → More redemptions → Feedback loop.

Name: BDC PIK Deterioration Loop
Key_Insight: Floating-rate stress → Portfolio companies can't pay cash → PIK (IOU) booked as income → NII inflated → Dividend appears covered → Cash runs out → Forced dividend cut → Market panic → "Covered" revealed as fiction.

Name: Deposit Flight Transmission
Key_Insight: Confidence shock → Uninsured deposits flee → Bank taps FHLB → FHLB advances spike → Haircut pressure → Forced asset sales → CRE repricing → SVB pattern. Social media accelerates runs.

Name: BDC Credit Line Cascade
Key_Insight: Credit stress → BDC portfolios mark down → BDCs draw bank lines ($142B unfunded, ~45% = $64B) → Bank liquidity drain exactly when banks need cash → FHLB surge. Hidden second-order effect.

Name: Federal Employment Channel
Key_Insight: DOGE cuts (277K+) → Geographic concentration (DC 24.6%, CO Springs 16.4%, VA Beach 16.1%) → Consumer/mortgage stress → Bank credit losses (AUB, EGBN exposed). Employment break is master variable.
